questionEn: Which formulation more accurately separates “Acid Rain” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formula "Kislota yomg'iri" ni o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq ajratib turadi?
choicesEn: The main cause of acid rain is the accumulation of nitrogen oxide (IV) NO2 and sulfur oxide in the atmosphere of our planet.
A complex substance that forms H⁺ (H₃O⁺) ions in an aqueous solution
choicesUz: Kislota yomg'irining asosiy sababi - azot oksidi (IV) NO2 va oltingugurt oksidining sayyoramiz atmosferasida to'planishi.
Suvli eritmada H⁺ (H₃O⁺) ionlarini hosil qiluvchi murakkab modda.
explanationEn: The main cause of acid rain is the accumulation of nitrogen (IV) oxide NO2 and sulfur oxide (IV) SO2 in the atmosphere of our planet.
explanationUz: Kislota yomg'irining asosiy sababi azot (IV) oksidi NO2 va oltingugurt oksidi (IV) SO2 ning sayyoramiz atmosferasida to'planishidir.
